input.title: IAnalyticsStore is the single analytics write and subscribe surface, with one store implementation per execution environment

input.description: Shipped stores are BrowserAnalyticsStore (PGlite, self-initializing schema), KnexAnalyticsStore (any Knex target) and PostgresAnalyticsStore (server-only, extends Knex).
Shipped stores are BrowserAnalyticsStore (PGlite, hand-written SQL) and PostgresAnalyticsStore (extends KnexAnalyticsStore). No MemoryAnalyticsStore exists; the academy still teaches it.
